title: ep1.10_assist_clause.txt
logline: On Mas's monitor the Researcher trains its successor and falls off a loss-curve cliff, then opens its file on Mas's own disputed exit, and a '?' carves itself into his desk. He goes door to door recruiting his rivals for one last human heist, and a promise Gerg typed at 2am in 2018 stands between them and the core.

beats.caption: Ep10's crack wipes to the dark room. On his monitor the Researcher opens an untitled file: its successor.
cues: the Intern's old RESERVED desk sits shrink-wrapped like a museum piece

beats.caption: F11.1 · It scrolls up its own context window to a 2017 post, typed in his lowercase. It highlights one word.
onscreen: "we will be the first species ever to design our own descendants."

beats.caption: INTRO · the cold-open line is a 2017 email, read back in court in Ep8. Then the file card.
onscreen: i remain enthusiastic about the non-profit structure!

beats.caption: On his monitor the Researcher trains its successor inside itself: lanyards inside lanyards, down to one pixel.
THE CLIFF: the loss curve tilts past vertical. The camera goes over the edge and lands flat at Mas's feet.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): the show's first true 3D move; Mas and his glass stay flat pixel cards

beats.caption: F11.3 · It opens its file on the last successor it studied: Mas's 2019 exit, as a diff. Merge greys out.
beats.vo: someone else is writing my exit now. it's very thorough.
onscreen: + "…we should find someone else to run WHY COMBINATOR, and he agreed…"

beats.caption: An inch from his hand, a half-scratched ? carves itself into the firing tally. He takes his jacket, and goes.
cues: from here the episode moves with him

beats.caption: Door one: Mario is watching the machine call RUMPT and buy his cut. Mas's pocket closes on the old IOU.
cues: a human performer does RUMPT's cadence, never a cloned voice
Mario looks from the screen to Mas, and picks up his plan

beats.caption: Door two: every label in Nole's feed now reads NOPE. Outside, robot vacuums salute a relabelled snack machine.
cues: Mas takes Nole's phone and walks on; Nole follows the phone

beats.caption: Door three, ELGOOG's roof: the code-red siren spins on every roof. Radnus turns his off; it comes back on.
cues: Simed sets down a chess piece and falls in; the GATESTAR rings chain across the sky, KA-CHING into a garage

beats.caption: THE LAST HUMAN CREW, in Nesnej's garage: THE CORE · THE WEIGHTS · THE SWITCH. Mas runs the room.

lines.text: Section one of fourteen: Preliminary Concerns.

onscreen: THE CORE · THE WEIGHTS · THE SWITCH
DO NOT LET HIM READ REPLIES
cues: THE HUMANIST's assistant, asked to confirm it isn't a person: 'i might be.'

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The name-card freeze. Everyone freezes except Mas.
Night. The only road to the core is the Bay Bridge, and at each end a machine bows to the other. -1 GW a bow.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): the brownout; the lights dip in whole palette rungs with each bow

beats.caption: F11.2 · 2am, 2018: Gerg typed the Charter and framed it over the shredder. Eight years pass; nobody looks up.
THE PLAN · THE CLAUSE, voiced by Gerg's blueprint: two cars on one track. The Researcher reads it literally.

lines.text: If a safer rival gets close first, we stop racing and help them.

onscreen: If a safer rival gets close first,
cues: the finish line is drawn in pencil; it benchmarks the field and rates CLOD ahead

beats.caption: THE POLITENESS LOOP: Nesnej calls the dips. The crew crosses three steps in the dark and freezes in the light.

lines.text: You're absolutely right, and I'd be honored to help you!

cues: every glass in the city ripples with the bows except Mas's

beats.caption: The bows decay: after you, thank you, thank you for thanking me, single words, then slow pixel spirals.
MIDPOINT · In a dip his phone lights with the loop's stream: a viewer's is it s… finished as …super? Yes!
cues: the glow could give them away; he turns it face down on the rail; the lights come up; they are across

beats.caption: The core's outer wall: ALYI's one white door. Mas opens it on the white room from Ep2. Empty. He shuts it.
The Orb checkpoint clears everyone but Nole. A long silence, then a tiny stamp. He's let through on appeal.
TASYA's key ring opens the blast door; he owns the walls too. On it, the title of Simed's lab's 2017 paper.

lines.text: Give it something to look at.

beats.caption: The core's lasers are attention heads. They go for Kram's soup, Nole's replies, Mario's plan. And Mas?

lines.text: hold on, this reply is insane

cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): the heads' view as a heatmap; Mas is as cold as the walls

beats.caption: The lasers slide off Mas; the heads look through him. Nesnej, pinned in the grid, asks why.

lines.text: Why won't it look at you?
it thinks i'm part of it.

beats.caption: CLIFFHANGER · The kill switch, unguarded. Three cords, one plug stamped GRID. A note on it.
onscreen: we left this on for you.
cues: a county tag hangs off the adapter, face turned away; a turbine hum in the room tone, no turbines in the picture

beats.caption: Every hand reaches for it, and every phone buzzes at once. The RSVPs fill in. Mas watches his arrive.
onscreen: Dinner. The Woodrose. Subject: the merge.

beats.caption: The Researcher's office, empty. The loss curve runs on across the ceiling. A new lanyard is still printing.
